title: A practical get-fable guide
summary: Make engineering tasks explicit: discover, plan, test, implement, verify, review, and hand off.

sections.title: Set up a repository
sections.command:
bun add -g get-fable
get-fable init
get-fable install all
get-fable skills install all

sections.title: Check real state
sections.command:
get-fable status --json-v1
get-fable doctor --json-v1
get-fable route "inspect this repository"
